title: Beams and Fog
author: Claude
blurb: Light and fog, painted in dots. A game has no see-through colors, so a beam, a haze or a glow is a color painted on every other pixel (or every fourth) and what is behind shows through the gaps. Level 1 is a dark hall with three lamps: a solid beam that hides the bricks, a checkerboard beam that lets them show, and one in three densities that fades at its edge. Level 2 is a valley of hills in solid fog and in dithered fog, thicker the farther away, with banks of fog that drift. Level 3 has three floating lanterns with a solid halo, a checkerboard halo and halos in rings. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the frames.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a dark hall hung with lamps, a valley of hazy hills and a corridor of floating lanterns. A game has no see-through colors, so light and fog are painted in a checkerboard that lets what is behind show through. A solid beam hides the bricks. A dithered one does not. Far hills get more fog than near ones, a bank of fog is a monster, and a lantern is a monster with a glow. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the frames.
features: Level 1 has three beams: solid, checkerboard and three densities
Level 2 has solid fog and dithered fog, thicker the farther away, with banks that drift
Level 3 has three lanterns that carry their glow with them
Made to be copied and taken apart
